Leah (CEO): Quick thread from today's all-hands Q&A: let's capture a few distinct signals about why were winning/losing and 1st-step asks. Keep each reply short.

Sam (Account Exec): Field note: Lost an enterprise pilot to governance concerns (model explainability & data lineage). Won a different pilot because our streaming API + tool-calling fit their realtime workflow.

Hana (Product): Concrete asks from GTM: 1) a short "governance checklist" for legal/AI-risk 2) an eval baseline customers can run (latency, hallucination rate) 3) rollback/runbook for model regressions.

Diego (Eng): From infra: we can produce a governance checklist + small demo that shows request tracing and provenance. Rollback playbook exists but needs a one-page distillation. Will estimate effort by Wed.

Priya (Customer Success): Customers would love a 1-page "what to show legal" sheet. Also ask: can we offer a sandbox demo that includes streaming + function-calls? That helped win the realtime buyer.

infra-bot: New ticket: ENG-3410 "Governance checklist + rollback one-pager" assigned to Diego. https://redwood.internal/ENG-3410

Leah (CEO): Owners: Diego -> ENG-3410; Hana -> create eval baseline template; Priya -> sample "legal sheet" + sandbox sign-up flow. Please post ETA by EoW.

Sam (Account Exec): I'll draft 3 "why we won" snippets: streaming fit, tool-calling, and clear cost model. Posting them to Sales Kit.

Hana (Product): Adding note: include an example metric for hallucination rate and a perf target (p95 < 300ms) in the baseline.

Leah (CEO): Great. Tag me if blockers pop up. Closing this thread once ETAs are posted. :white_check_mark:
